assertions.name: habiro_infrastructure_reproduces_witness
assertions.source: habiro_sum_mp(atom, u0) matches tr_M_at_q0 to ≤ 10 ppm via the corrected (u;u)_m Pochhammer + D(u) division.

description: Q_β Habiro element search — keystone probe per 1ppq-qbeta.md PROBE NEW. (A) verify habiro_exact_qbeta.py reproduces witness tr_M to ≤ 10 ppm; (B) test α_EM-parallel candidate Habiro elements [2]_q·(1−h²α)-style for Q_β c_k; (C) enumerate structural constraints from the witness file.

subtask_C_constraints.name: C1: integer Habiro coefficients (Habiro 2002)
subtask_C_constraints.claim: a_m ∈ ℤ[u] for every m, both proton & neutron

subtask_C_constraints.name: C2: shared denominator structure
subtask_C_constraints.claim: whether a single D(u) clears both tr_M_p and tr_M_n; true under convention C, false under D

subtask_C_constraints.name: C3: Habiro termination order
subtask_C_constraints.claim: M_max = 8 for both p and n (single-wrap braids)

subtask_C_constraints.name: C4: leading Habiro coefficient
subtask_C_constraints.claim: a_0 = 4 for both p and n; this 4 is the dim of V_(2,1) ⊕ V_(1,1,1) = 2+1 = 3, mod the χ_(2,1) normalization. Specific value of 4 = degree of the Markov denominator in u.

subtask_C_constraints.name: C5: sign alternation in low-m coefficients
subtask_C_constraints.claim: a_0 > 0, a_1 < 0, a_2 > 0, a_3 < 0 for both atoms (signature of Habiro element with positive q₀ → 1 limit)

subtask_C_constraints.name: C6: neutron-proton coefficient difference
subtask_C_constraints.claim: Δa_m(u) := a_m(n) - a_m(p) is the Q_β-relevant Habiro element.
subtask_C_constraints.reason: n - p: the two witnesses' denominators differ, so subtracting their a_m builds d_X*t_X - d_Y*t_Y, not the pair difference. Use trace_diff_numerator(tr_x, tr_y, sym) and expand THAT (bean qou-0ndb / qou-lnog).
subtask_C_constraints.required_restructure: expand trace_diff_numerator(tr_n, tr_p, sym) rather than differencing two separately-cleared expansions

verdict.subtask_B_status: NEGATIVE — no α_EM-parallel candidate matches c_2 AND c_3 simultaneously
verdict.subtask_C_status: CONSTRAINTS-NARROWED (5 of 6) — C6 refused: the pair's denominators differ under convention D, so a_m-differencing does not build the pair difference (qou-0ndb / qou-lnog)
verdict.overall_status: PARTIAL — infrastructure validated (A), naive ansätze fail (B), constraints documented for next session (C)
